name: Fluent UI System Color Icons
about: Fluent UI System Color Icons is a free, open-source icon set with 890 icons designed by Microsoft Corporation. From navigation and actions to files, media and communication, it covers everyday UI needs. Every icon is available as SVG, PNG and WebP, or as a copy-paste React / TypeScript component or CDN link. Recolor and resize each one in the browser before you export – free, no account needed. Licensed under MIT.

faqs.q: Are Fluent UI System Color Icons free to use?
faqs.a: Yes. All 890 Fluent UI System Color Icons are open source under the MIT license – free to download, customize and use. Always check the MIT terms for attribution or commercial-use requirements.

faqs.q: How do I use Fluent UI System Color Icons in React or my website?
faqs.a: Copy any icon as a React / TypeScript component straight into your project, or paste the CDN link into your HTML. Every icon also downloads as SVG, PNG or WebP, and you can recolor and resize it in the browser before you export.

faqs.q: How many Fluent UI System Color Icons are there?
faqs.a: There are 890 icons in the Fluent UI System Color Icons set, designed by Microsoft Corporation. Use the search above to find any icon by name.

faqs.q: Can I change the color and size of Fluent UI System Color Icons?
faqs.a: Yes. Open any icon, pick a size and color, and the preview updates instantly. SVG, PNG and WebP exports follow your choices, and React snippets recolor through props.

faqs.q: What formats are Fluent UI System Color Icons available in?
faqs.a: SVG, PNG and WebP downloads, copy-paste React / TypeScript components, plus a CDN link for every single icon – free, no account needed.
